# The small line under "SkyLyrics" at the top left of the settings sidebar, in the game's language. On main it reads
# "by Beli" in every language; on fix/i18n131 it reads "от Beli" in Russian, "מאת Beli" in Hebrew and "von Beli" in
# German, and stays inside the sidebar. (The branch's other fix, the Mac Status texts, can't show on Linux: tests only.)
# Compare a branch with main by running it twice.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch or commit> -f script=.github/checks/i18n131.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6

lang ru_ru
sleep 15
gui 0
sleep 3
shot byline-ru
close

lang he_il
sleep 15
gui 0
sleep 3
shot byline-he
close

lang de_de
sleep 15
gui 0
sleep 3
shot byline-de
close

lang en_us
sleep 15
